docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Shama Sastri’s Calcutta lectures on the growth of political institutions in India from the Vedic age through the Arthaśāstra to the Mauryan state (Calcutta, 1920). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Evolution of Indian polity · Shama Sastri, R. (Rudrapatna) · 1920, 202 scanned pages. Published 1920; R. Shama Sastri died 1944; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
